title: Attacking Tabular Foundation Models: An Experimental Taxonomy of Context Poisoning and Test-Time Evasion
abstract: arXiv:2611.29627v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tabular foundation models condition predictions on labeled examples supplied at inference time, creating an attack surface that differs from conventional model training. We study four manipulation families (label flipping, backdoor context poisoning, clean-label context selection, and test-time evasion) and organize them by attack stage, label consistency, and distributional realism. TabPFN-2.5, TabICL, and XGBoost are evaluated on CIC-IDS2017 and N-BaIoT using a common preprocessing and evaluation pipeline. Backdoor context poisoning provides strong targeted control over the in-context models with little change in clean accuracy, whereas selecting real, correctly labeled boundary-crowding rows causes no systematic accuracy degradation up to a 20% bias fraction. A simplified surrogate-transfer constrained PGD attack inspired by, but not equivalent to, CAPGD also produces test-time evasion, outperforming equal-budget random noise in most

translated_title: 攻击表格基础模型：上下文污染与测试时逃逸的实验分类
translated_abstract: 表格基础模型在推理时以推理阶段提供的标注示例为条件进行预测，这形成了一个不同于传统模型训练的攻击面。我们研究了四类操纵方法（标签翻转、后门上下文污染、干净标签上下文选择和测试时逃逸），并按照攻击阶段、标签一致性和分布真实性对其进行分类组织。我们在CIC-IDS2017和N-BaIoT数据集上，使用统一的预处理与评估流程对TabPFN-2.5、TabICL和XGBoost进行了评估。结果表明，后门上下文污染能够在几乎不改变干净准确率的情况下对上下文模型实现强目标性控制；而选择真实的、正确标注的边界拥挤行（干净标签攻击）即使偏置比例高达20%，也不会造成系统性的准确率下降。此外，一个受CAPGD启发但不等同于此的简化代理迁移约束PGD攻击同样可以实现测试时逃逸，并在大多数情况下优于同等预算的随机噪声攻击。
tldr: 该论文对表格基础模型推理时上下文学习机制的攻击提出了系统性实验分类，发现后门上下文污染可在几乎不降低干净准确率的前提下实现对模型预测的强目标性控制。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a systematic experimental taxonomy of attacks exploiting the in-context learning mechanism of tabular foundation models, showing that backdoor context poisoning achieves strong targeted control with little degradation in clean accuracy.
